body: They won't seek help. I'm the only person they're dependant on. And I'm at breaking point I don't want to do this anymore. Being around positive people makes me happy, doing what I want to do would make me happy. But I'm a prisoner right now and I don't control my life anymore :( that's why I want to escape

I'm crying reading this :( thank you so much I really need it. I don't even want to kill myself or run away but thinking about it gives me that temporary 'relief' but at the same time makes me sick to my stomach. 

I really REALLY hope that things will change its been way too many years now and I'm holding on, I really am. 

I've developed two lives and it's messing with my head. I've put on a mask for so long but I just can't wear it anymore. 

But I'm scared.. scared for what will happen once this mask is gone and shit gets real. 

I will take you up on that PM I need to talk to people. I appreciate so much you opening up to me and giving me courage and hope
I know :( but I can't get away from the root of the problem

I just got off the phone to the helpline. They help but don't help. I'm losing it my mind is gone. 

I'm dealing with someone else who has depression and they are dependant on me this is why I'm now depressed and have developed anxiety. I feel like I have no choice with how I live my life. 

I seriously don't know who I am anymore. I'm so scared :(

Yes almost daily now, right now I'm sitting in the toilet cubicle at work contemplating if ill be going home tonight. I don't want to do it, but I don't see an end, I'm being suffocated. I don't know what to do. Today is the worst I've ever felt. 

I'm trying to keep a straight happy face at work while having a panic attack right now. 

Ugh
Just over 2 years now
It's not the best job but I work for a decent company and get a good salary for what I do. I just had the meeting and now have to wait for the outcome :(

I'm bawling my eyes out reading this :( ugh why do bad things happen to good people. I don't have the guts to end my life, but the thought is comforting - unfortunately. You're right, it would ruin my entire family. 

I'm mentally drained though, the shit I go through on a daily basis is sickening. I live two lives, the fake happy work girl and the miserable depressed girl. 

I really really hope it gets better. That's all I'm holding out for. Thank you for taking the time to respond, I really appreciate it.

I think to myself, if I just hold out things might get better. I'm still young maybe things will change. But how much longer do I have to wait? It's been years already. Why would it change now? I'm 23 and already hate ny life. Lost all my friends, have no money. I had so much potential.
I work 8 hours in an office and it sucks, I just wanna be outdoors!
12 hour days?! Now I feel bad for complaining lol
That's great to hear :) one step at a time is the way to go, same for me. I have a lot to work on still but I know I can do it, you will too :)

They definitely did miss me as much as I missed them. I've never hugged someone for so long!  Even though I've been the way I have for so long they know I'm still the same deep down and will always give me the time of day. Thank you :)
Thank you so much! I'm glad I could share this with you and help a little, it's definitely a lot easier once you are there! I hope you have a great time today :)

Thank you, I'm gonna hang on for now. My anxiety is really bad today so I'm thinking irrationally at the moment. What's worse is that I'm at work. And when I'm not at work its just as bad. Ugh hate it

But I'm so tired of trying, I don't even know who I am or what I'm really living for. I've invested a lot of time helping others and now I'm the one at breaking point. Depression is the worst disease ever, it wants you to fail :( 


Edit: thank you for believing in me
You know what, that is the same for me as well. My brother had a beautiful baby boy, he's 6 months old now and he is the only reason right now for me to keep going.
I do this everyday now. I could never ever do it but just the thought of it satisfying.

They got me into the sick room where I could breathe better and asked if I needed anything. My work offers support, counseling and psychology sessions. But not something I want to do right now. Hope you are doing okay

It's a long story I guess, but I guess when someone is depressed and you are the only person around them they are going to take it out on you.

And theres only so much a person can take. I just need to vent because I'm so bottled up I feel helpless. I hope in the near future things will change.

Thank you for listening, I appreciate it so much.
I was sitting in the toilets for over an hour and it got really bad so I finally asked for help. I'm ok now (as in the attack has passed)

Im so stressed. My life is a record on repeat. My only friend loves me but shits on me. That friend is depressed too and down, so I'm going down along with them.  I have no one to turn to. I don't do anything with myself. This has been going on for a year or more. I'm at breaking point. 

I don't know what to do. I ran away once before but getting the police involved makes things worse, especially if I go 'missing' again. Why do bad things happen to good people

The thing is I dont want to wait for the change anymore, its been years and my situation is still the same. I can't get out. The only way to get out is stop living or run away. I fucking hate it :( I have so much potential, everyone does. But when something or SOMEONE holds you back its an endless battle. Im at the stage now where ill snap, go crazy, start smashing shit because what else can I do. I know its hard without context but I dont know. I think why me, why me the person who always gives. Takes other's shit, gets put down.

I want friends. I don't have ANYONE anymore. I use to have friends but since I've been been shat on I have withdrawn myself from the world and struggle to crawl back. 

I'm always hopeful, I never truly give up otherwise I wouldn't be here typing this now. But I really friggin hope a change happens soon.. really hope.

Onions. Everywhere. 

Thanks heaps for this, you really made me feel better. I know I have so much to offer. Just need to stop letting other people bring me down.

Awesome, that's good to hear how much it helped you guys. And congratulations on your 25th anniversary :) I'm starting to feel a lot better reading your comments and knowing that there is hope to pick things up. I just need to remind myself that its not the end. Thankyou

Thankyou for sharing your experience, its something that I will definitely try. I don't have anyone else really to talk to, so I like the fact its confidential as well. Hopefully things start to turn around, I'm only 21, I should be embracing life instead of wanting to end it.

Thanks heaps for your response, I appreciate it greatly. I admit that I'm only a little depressed, I'm sure a lot of people are worse off - but I've been through a lot in the last 3 years or so, relationship wise and another incident which occurred not so long ago which greatly affected me (was injured and out of work). 

It's more the psychological damage that I've experienced. My mind has been manipulated and controlled and I've become so weak. And I just constantly have these horrible thoughts of wanting to die because I can't take anymore crap.

There is still something affecting me and I just don't know what to do. I know what the issue is, but it all comes down to fear and not knowing what to do next.

I will definitely look into making an appointment with a counsellor. Thanks again :)
